files.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the repository greeting from the source-of-truth file.

The greeting is read from src/greeting.txt at runtime so that the file
remains the single source of truth and the one-line rule is preserved.
"""
from pathlib import Path

GREETING_PATH = Path("src/greeting.txt")


def main() -> None:
    print(GREETING_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), end="")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
